title: Scalar associativity on the profinite slice
statement: For every commutative condensed ring Lambda [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and every profinite S, the fixed profiniteScalarRealization [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model] is naturally isomorphic to moduleDerivedExtension along the actual profiniteScalarMap followed by Evaluation.F on the slice over S. No extremal disconnectedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Restriction to the slice preserves constants. Its monoidal restriction comparison identifies the point coefficient map with the terminal scalar counit after the actual scalar map R to A.

Choose a flat-term K-flat representative. Constants commute with scalar extension. Pullback preserves K-flatness, and the balanced tensor maps b tensor (a tensor p) to ba tensor p and b tensor p to b tensor (1 tensor p) are inverse natural chain maps.
Tensor descent localizes these comparisons to every unbounded complex. On the empty slice A is the zero ring and both sides are zero, so no nonempty hypothesis is needed.
